npc.deadlands.rumour.condition.military: The army held it for a while. Their stores were never emptied.
npc.deadlands.rumour.condition.survivor: There are people there. Decent ones, last I heard.
npc.deadlands.rumour.condition.abandoned: Empty for a long time. Picked over, mostly.
npc.deadlands.rumour.0: They hear better than they see. Walk, do not run, and shut the doors behind you.
npc.deadlands.rumour.1: Every fifth night they come together. If you count the days, you will know when to be indoors.
npc.deadlands.rumour.2: A light at night is an invitation. So is an engine.
npc.deadlands.rumour.3: Some of the pumps still have fuel in them. Most do not. You only find out by trying.
npc.deadlands.rumour.4: If you see a mound that breathes, do not make a sound near it.
npc.deadlands.rumour.5: A bite is not the end if you clean it at once. Leave it a day and you will wish you had not.

npc.deadlands.place.powered: This is %s. %s And the lights are on again, which is more than anyone hoped for.
npc.deadlands.place.dark: This is %s. %s We sit in the dark at night. Someone with a fuse and the nerve could change that.

npc.deadlands.heal.infected: Nothing I can stitch. But that bite needs antiseptic, or better, and soon.
npc.deadlands.heal.done: Hold still. There. You will live.
npc.deadlands.heal.done_infected: That is the wounds seen to. The infection I cannot cut out. You need medicine for that.
npc.deadlands.repair.none: Bring it closer. I am not walking out there to look at it.
npc.deadlands.repair.done: That %s will get you where you are going now.
npc.deadlands.repair.more: Better. That %s still needs more than I have here.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.greeting: %s. You made it. Sit down, I have a lot to tell you and not much time.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.story.0: I was a researcher at the regional lab when the first cases came in. Ninety days ago. It feels like years.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.story.1: We thought it was a fever. By the time we understood what it did to the brain, half the staff had turned.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.story.2: I kept my notes. Samples too, until the power failed. If I could get tissue from the nests, I could start again.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.story.3: There were three others who helped me get out. We were separated on the road. I do not know who is still alive.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.story.4: I am not looking for a cure for the dead. I am looking for a way to keep the living from joining them.
npc.deadlands.character.itzbreadloaf.gre: Oh, a person. A real one. Do not touch the engine, %s, I only just got it to stop screaming.
npc.deadlands.character.itzbreadloaf.sto: I drove a delivery van. Bread, mostly. Go on, laugh. Everyone does.
When the roads jammed I learned to fix what I was driving, because nobody else was going to.
I got a doctor out of the city in the back of that van. Harley. Clever. Did not sleep the whole way.
Lost her at a roadblock. I keep the van ready in case I ever find the others.
npc.deadlands.character.imlilylol.greeti: %s, is it? I know a hundred names and yours is new. Come and see what I am carrying.
I never stayed anywhere long, even before. Now it is a profession.
I trade what one town has too much of for what the next one is dying without. It keeps both alive. And me.
I walked with three others for a while. A scientist, a driver and a man who never put his rifle down.
I hear things on the road. If any of them are alive, I will be the first to know. I will tell you if you ask.
npc.deadlands.character.felixsyn.greetin: Stop there. Let me look at you. All right, %s. You can come closer.
npc.deadlands.character.felixsyn.story.0: I was on the checkpoint detail when the order came to fall back. Most of the unit did not get the chance.
npc.deadlands.character.felixsyn.story.1: I stopped taking orders the day they told us to leave the civilians. I took four of them with me instead.
npc.deadlands.character.felixsyn.story.2: One of them was a scientist who thought she could stop it. I decided that was worth guarding.
npc.deadlands.character.felixsyn.story.3: We were scattered on the fifth night. I have stood watch here since, in case any of them come this way.

lore.deadlands.harley_research_1.title: Research Note 1: Onset
lore.deadlands.harley_research_1.body: Incubation four to nine hours from a bite, under two from deep tissue exposure. Fever first, then a lucid stretch that fools everyone, families most of all. Pupils stop responding before the patient stops talking. Write this on every wall you can.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_2.title: Research Note 2: The Brain Stem
lore.deadlands.harley_research_2.body: NR-7 does exactly what it was built to do. It regenerates. It just does not stop at the wound. It rebuilds the brain stem around itself and keeps only what feeds it: movement, hunger, pursuit. The rest of the person is not destroyed. It is disconnected.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_3.title: Research Note 3: Nests
lore.deadlands.harley_research_3.body: The biomass in the nests is not waste. It is a colony. Samples taken near a nest core show NR-7 in a dormant, almost seed-like form. Dormant means stable. Stable means I can study it without it studying me back.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_4.title: Research Note 4: Sound
lore.deadlands.harley_research_4.body: They hunt by sound before sight. A car door carries a hundred blocks on a still night. The screamers are not calling for help; they are calling the others. Kill the screamer first or leave before it finishes.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_5.title: Research Note 5: An Inhibitor?
lore.deadlands.harley_research_5.body: If NR-7 can be told to stop, it is told by a protein it makes itself, in tiny amounts, in the first carrier only. The first strain had a brake. Every copy since has lost it. I need the original. I need to know who P-0 was.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_6.title: Research Note 6: Requirements
lore.deadlands.harley_research_6.body: To finish an inhibitor I need: fresh tissue from the hospital's pathology freezers, the Kessler trial documents, Patient Zero's records, whatever the army took from us, and the formula notes Rourke kept to himself. And samples from the big ones, if anyone is mad enough to get close.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_7.title: Research Note 7: The Large Forms
lore.deadlands.harley_research_7.body: Some of them grow. Not bigger zombies: different animals. The agent concentrates in them like a reactor. One sample from any of the large forms holds more active NR-7 than a hundred of the common infected. Dangerous. Invaluable.
lore.deadlands.harley_research_8.title: Research Note 8: For Whoever Reads This
lore.deadlands.harley_research_8.body: If I do not come back, everything is in the field case. Give it to someone with a lab and a generator. Do not give it to the army. They had our data for three months before the first case and they used it to plan a fence.
lore.deadlands.harley_journal_1.title: Harley's Journal: The Expedition
lore.deadlands.harley_journal_1.body: Day -31. Four of us now. The driver, Itzbreadloaf, will not stop talking, which keeps the rest of us awake. FelixSyn keeps watch like he expects the trees to attack. Imlilylol found us, not the other way round. We go to the nests tomorrow.
lore.deadlands.harley_journal_2.title: Harley's Journal: Samples
lore.deadlands.harley_journal_2.body: Day -29. Three good samples from the nest by the river. Felix carried me out when the screamer started. I owe him more than I can write here. Tomorrow we try for the clinic in town. We need a freezer, and a fence that still stands.
lore.deadlands.harley_journal_3.title: Harley's Journal: Separated
lore.deadlands.harley_journal_3.body: Day -28. Roadblock. Gunfire from our own side. We scattered. I ran until I could not. I left the field case under the third tent because I could not carry it and run. If anyone finds this: I am alive. I am going back to the lab road. I will not stop.
lore.deadlands.itz_log_1.title: Itzbreadloaf's Logbook: Route 9
lore.deadlands.itz_log_1.body: Monday. Bread, forty trays. Two stops closed, one had a soldier at the door telling me to turn round. Thursday. Nobody signs for anything any more. Saturday. Dropped the bread at the church because people were hungry and the shop was gone.
lore.deadlands.itz_log_2.title: Itzbreadloaf's Logbook: The Doctor
lore.deadlands.itz_log_2.body: Picked up a doctor walking the lab road with a case she would not let me touch. Harley. Talked about proteins for an hour. I understood about four words. She fell asleep against the window with her hand on that case.
lore.deadlands.itz_log_3.title: Itzbreadloaf's Logbook: Repairs
lore.deadlands.itz_log_3.body: Van threw a belt on the hill. Fixed it with a belt from a lawnmower and a prayer. Felix says I talk to the engine. Felix is right. Engine says it needs a proper set of parts and two tyres that are not held together by optimism.
lore.deadlands.itz_log_4.title: Itzbreadloaf's Logbook: Roadblock
lore.deadlands.itz_log_4.body: Lost them. Soldiers at the roadblock shot at the van. Not at the dead. At us. I drove until the fuel light came on and then I kept going. I am fixing her up. When she runs I am going back for every one of them.
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_1.title: Imlilylol's Letter to Nobody
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_1.body: I write these and leave them where travellers rest. Maybe one finds someone I know. If you are reading this: the water at the north pumps is clean, the bridge on the east road is down, and nobody in the bandit towns keeps their word.
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_2.title: Imlilylol's Letter: The Scientist
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_2.body: Walked with a scientist for a while. She looked at the dead the way I look at a map: where did you come from, where are you going. I liked her. I told her I would find her again. I keep my word, mostly.
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_3.title: Imlilylol's Letter: Radio
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_3.body: Somebody is still broadcasting on 91.2. Survivors, settlements, the odd idiot singing. If I could get one of the old radio towers working I could reach the whole county. I could find them.
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_4.title: Imlilylol's Letter: The Airfield
lore.deadlands.lily_letter_4.body: A soldier I traded with swore there is a helicopter at Site Calder. Hidden hangar, a pad painted to look like a car park. They left in a hurry and left one behind. He wanted three cans of fuel for that story. I gave him two.
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_1.title: FelixSyn's Field Notes: Meridian
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_1.body: Assigned to Camp Meridian. Colonel Hale wants a perimeter by dawn. Okafor asked who the perimeter keeps out. Hale did not answer. I should have asked again.
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_2.title: FelixSyn's Field Notes: The Order
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_2.body: Order came down at 0300: gates closed, no exceptions. There were two hundred people outside the wire. Families. I watched Okafor put her rifle down. Then I put mine down. We walked out through the east gate before they could lock it.
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_3.title: FelixSyn's Field Notes: The Doctor
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_3.body: We found a lab tech who walked out of Kessler with nothing but her badge. She says the army knew. She says Hale knew. I believe her, because I was there when he read the orders and he did not look surprised. I asked her about a Dr. Harley. She said Harley got out. That is all she knew. It is more than I had yesterday.
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_4.title: FelixSyn's Field Notes: If I See Him Again
lore.deadlands.felix_notes_4.body: If Hale is still out there, dead or alive, I owe him a conversation. If he is dead and walking, I owe him rest. Either way I want the orders. The real ones, with his signature. People should know who closed that gate.
lore.deadlands.trail_itzbreadloaf.title: A Note Pinned to a Fuel Pump
lore.deadlands.trail_itzbreadloaf.body: Gone to %1$s, %2$s of here, about %3$s blocks. Heard they have a garage and nobody guarding the parts. If you are Harley, or Felix, or anyone who knows a doctor with a case: wait for me. - the bread guy
lore.deadlands.trail_imlilylol.title: A Letter Left at a Camp
lore.deadlands.trail_imlilylol.body: Heading for %1$s, %2$s, perhaps %3$s blocks if the road holds. Trading there for a few days. If this reaches the scientist or her friends: I have news, and I would rather give it to your face. - Lily
lore.deadlands.trail_felixsyn.title: Words Scratched Inside a Checkpoint Booth
lore.deadlands.trail_felixsyn.body: F.S. moving to %1$s. %2$s, %3$s blocks. Holding there. Do not follow if you are army.
lore.deadlands.mil_lantern_brief.title: Project LANTERN: Briefing
lore.deadlands.mil_lantern_brief.body: CLASSIFIED. Project LANTERN seeks to restore function to soldiers with catastrophic injuries using the neural regeneration agent NR-7. Human trials authorised at Kessler Regional Research Laboratory under Dr. V. Rourke. Military oversight: Col. M. Hale.
lore.deadlands.mil_breach_report.title: Incident Report: Kessler Containment
lore.deadlands.mil_breach_report.body: Day -95. Containment failure, Wing D. Subject P-0 unaccounted for. Two staff injured, one missing (V-ASK, L., animal care). Civil authorities NOT to be informed. Cover story: chemical leak. Signed: Col. M. Hale.
lore.deadlands.mil_knew.title: Memorandum: Public Notification
lore.deadlands.mil_knew.body: Day -88. Projections indicate county-wide spread within 21 days. Recommend public notification be delayed to prevent disorder on evacuation routes. Priority: preservation of LANTERN data and personnel. Population management via Camp Meridian.
lore.deadlands.mil_meridian_orders.title: Camp Meridian: Standing Orders
lore.deadlands.mil_meridian_orders.body: 1. Screen all arrivals for fever. 2. Fever cases to Ward C. 3. Ward C is not to be opened for any reason. 4. When capacity is reached, gates close. Capacity is reached when the Colonel says it is reached.
lore.deadlands.mil_gate_order.title: Order 0300
lore.deadlands.mil_gate_order.body: All gates to be sealed at 0300. No further admissions. Personnel who refuse this order are to be treated as deserters. Signed, Colonel Marcus Hale. Below, in another hand: two hundred and twelve people outside. God forgive us.
lore.deadlands.mil_ward_c.title: Ward C Log
lore.deadlands.mil_ward_c.body: Day -58: 40 in Ward C. Day -57: 90. Day -56: staff withdrawn. Day -55: noises from Ward C have changed. Something heavy against the door. The door is bending outward. Day -54: no further entries.
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_1.title: Pvt. Okafor's Log, 1
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_1.body: They say we are protecting people. Mostly we are counting them. Sergeant says don't count, it gets in your head. Felix counts anyway, under his breath. Four hundred and six today.
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_2.title: Pvt. Okafor's Log, 2
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_2.body: Saw the Colonel take a call in the truck. He said 'how long do we have' and then 'understood' and then he sat there for a long time. When he came out he told us to double the wire.
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_3.title: Pvt. Okafor's Log, 3
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_3.body: Walked out with Felix. We will be shot if they find us. I don't care. There was a girl at the wire with a stuffed rabbit and I am not going to be the one who tells her no.
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_4.title: Pvt. Okafor's Log, 4
lore.deadlands.mil_okafor_4.body: Bitten. Felix doesn't know. I have maybe a day of being me. Felix, if you find this: you did right. Find the doctor. Make it mean something.
lore.deadlands.mil_calder_manifest.title: Site Calder: Evacuation Manifest
lore.deadlands.mil_calder_manifest.body: Rotary-wing assets: 3. Departed: 2. Remaining: 1, grounded (rotor damage, avionics fault). Leave it. Fuel tanks drained, turbine components packed for transport and never collected.
lore.deadlands.mil_calder_access.title: Site Calder: Access Levels
lore.deadlands.mil_calder_access.body: Green cards: perimeter, stores. Blue cards: hangar, motor pool. Red cards: command, armoury, the Kessler archive. Lost cards must be reported to the Colonel personally.
lore.deadlands.mil_checkpoint_log.title: Checkpoint 7 Log
lore.deadlands.mil_checkpoint_log.body: 0600 quiet. 0900 two cars turned back. 1300 a man with a fever begged to be let through to see his kids. Turned back. 1800 he came back. Not a man any more. Turned him back with the rifle.
lore.deadlands.mil_hale_last.title: Colonel Hale's Last Entry
lore.deadlands.mil_hale_last.body: I followed every order. I wrote half of them. When the dead reached the command post I locked myself in and I can hear them in the corridor wearing my officers' faces. If this is judgment, it is fair.
lore.deadlands.mil_e12_log.title: Observation Log: Subject E-12
lore.deadlands.mil_e12_log.body: E-12 shows enhanced regeneration and limb elongation. Spits a caustic fluid when cornered. Responds to its old name for about four seconds before it stops. Recommend termination. Request denied by Dr. Rourke: 'we learn more alive'.
lore.deadlands.mil_e12_escape.title: Incident: E-12
lore.deadlands.mil_e12_escape.body: E-12 breached its enclosure by dissolving the hinges. Last seen heading for the treeline. Search abandoned after the second team failed to report. Do not approach. It remembers the people who hurt it.
lore.deadlands.p0_1.title: Patient Zero Records, 1
lore.deadlands.p0_1.body: Subject P-0. Sgt. Elias Harley, 27. Injury: spinal, total paralysis from an IED. Volunteered for NR-7 trial on condition his family not be told. Sister is a researcher in the civilian wing. Request granted.
lore.deadlands.p0_2.title: Patient Zero Records, 2
lore.deadlands.p0_2.body: Day 6 of trial. P-0 moved his toes. Day 9: stood. Day 12: walked the length of the ward and asked for his sister. Request denied. P-0 cried. We noted elevated NR-7 expression.
lore.deadlands.p0_3.title: Patient Zero Records, 3
lore.deadlands.p0_3.body: Day 19. P-0 shows aggression in the evenings, lucidity in the mornings. He asked us to stop. He said 'something else is learning to use my hands'. Dr. Rourke increased the dose.
lore.deadlands.p0_4.title: Patient Zero Records, 4
lore.deadlands.p0_4.body: Day 24. P-0 produces a regulatory protein no later carrier shows. Rourke calls it 'the brake'. With the brake present, NR-7 holds. Without it, it consumes. Blood from P-0 is the only source.
lore.deadlands.p0_5.title: Patient Zero Records, 5
lore.deadlands.p0_5.body: Day 25. P-0 broke restraints during the night shift. He did not attack the orderly. He opened every cell in Wing D and walked out into the rain. Vask followed him. Neither came back.
lore.deadlands.p0_6.title: Patient Zero Records, 6: Elias's Note
lore.deadlands.p0_6.body: Found on the body in his own handwriting: H, I am still in here. Not all the time. It keeps me because I am useful to it. If you find me, take what you need. Make them stop. I am sorry I did not tell you. - E
lore.deadlands.med_sato_1.title: Dr. Sato's Ward Notes, 1
lore.deadlands.med_sato_1.body: Day -86. Six fever cases, all from the north of the county. Bloods unremarkable apart from an unidentified protein. Asked the county lab to look at it. They said Kessler had already asked for our samples.
lore.deadlands.med_sato_2.title: Dr. Sato's Ward Notes, 2
lore.deadlands.med_sato_2.body: Day -80. Forty cases. Patients die, then they get up. I have written that sentence three times and crossed it out twice. Security has stopped answering their radios.
lore.deadlands.med_sato_3.title: Dr. Sato's Ward Notes, 3
lore.deadlands.med_sato_3.body: Day -76. We have moved everyone who can walk to the top floor and barricaded the stairs. The pathology freezers are full of samples nobody will ever analyse. If anyone wants them, they are in the basement. Bring a torch.
lore.deadlands.med_sato_4.title: Dr. Sato's Ward Notes, 4
lore.deadlands.med_sato_4.body: Day -74. Army helicopter landed on the roof. They took the samples and two of our doctors. Not the patients. I stayed. Somebody has to.
lore.deadlands.med_intake.title: Patient Intake Form
lore.deadlands.med_intake.body: Name: illegible. Complaint: bitten by neighbour. Temperature 40.1. Notes: patient insists the neighbour was dead before the bite. Referred to psychiatry. Psychiatry not answering.
lore.deadlands.med_autopsy.title: Autopsy Report 0412
lore.deadlands.med_autopsy.body: Brain stem enlarged and fibrous. Higher brain intact but isolated, as if someone cut the wires and left the house standing. Subject re-animated during the procedure. Procedure discontinued.
lore.deadlands.med_pharmacy.title: Pharmacy Note
lore.deadlands.med_pharmacy.body: No more antibiotics, they don't work anyway. No more painkillers, people fight over them. Bandages on the left shelf. If you take the last of something, leave a note so the next person doesn't waste the trip.
lore.deadlands.med_triage.title: Triage Card
lore.deadlands.med_triage.body: RED: immediate. YELLOW: delayed. GREEN: minor. BLACK: expectant. Someone has added a fifth colour in marker, grey, with one word next to it: watch.
lore.deadlands.med_nurse.title: Nurse's Note
lore.deadlands.med_nurse.body: Mum, I'm staying. They need everyone. Don't come to the hospital whatever you hear on the radio. Lock the door and only open it for me. I'll knock three times. I love you. - J
lore.deadlands.med_blood_drive.title: Blood Drive Flyer
lore.deadlands.med_blood_drive.body: Ashford General needs you! Give blood this Saturday at the school gym. Free juice and biscuits. Someone has written across it: THEY TOOK IT ALL TO KESSLER.
lore.deadlands.med_ward_c_intake.title: Ward C Transfer List
lore.deadlands.med_ward_c_intake.body: Ninety-one names, transferred from Ashford General to Camp Meridian, Ward C, for 'observation'. Not one discharge recorded. The last page is soaked through and stuck to the clipboard.
lore.deadlands.med_vask_file.title: Personnel File: Leon Vask
lore.deadlands.med_vask_file.body: Animal care technician, Kessler. Duties: feeding and restraint of trial subjects. Complaints from staff: 'talks to the subjects', 'brings them meat from home'. Reprimanded twice. Badge never returned.
lore.deadlands.med_vask_note.title: A Note in a Butcher's Hand
lore.deadlands.med_vask_note.body: They are hungry all the time. Nobody else feeds them right. I feed them. They know my step now. They are my animals and nobody is taking them away from me.
lore.deadlands.med_sample_label.title: Sample Freezer Inventory
lore.deadlands.med_sample_label.body: Rack 3: NR-7 positive, early. Rack 4: NR-7 positive, late. Rack 5: controls. Rack 6: removed by military personnel, day -74. Racks 3 and 4 intact. Keep frozen.
lore.deadlands.gov_emergency.title: County Emergency Declaration
lore.deadlands.gov_emergency.body: A state of emergency is declared in Ashford County. Residents are asked to remain indoors, report fever cases to the hotline, and await evacuation instructions. Do not attempt to restrain the sick.
lore.deadlands.gov_evac_notice.title: Evacuation Notice
lore.deadlands.gov_evac_notice.body: Residents of this district will be evacuated to Camp Meridian. Bring identification, medication and one bag. Pets cannot be accommodated. Buses depart from the school at 0700. Do not be late. Buses will not wait.
lore.deadlands.gov_curfew.title: Curfew Order
lore.deadlands.gov_curfew.body: A curfew is in effect from dusk to dawn. Anyone outdoors after dark may be detained. Lights must be kept low. Noise must be kept to a minimum. Stay inside. Stay quiet. Stay alive.
lore.deadlands.gov_hotline.title: Fever Hotline Script
lore.deadlands.gov_hotline.body: Ask: is the person conscious? Is the person aggressive? Has the person been bitten? If YES to any: advise the caller to leave the building and wait for assistance. Note: assistance is no longer being dispatched.
lore.deadlands.gov_census.title: Census of the Dead
lore.deadlands.gov_census.body: District 4: 1,212 deceased, 380 missing, 94 accounted for. District 5: no response. District 6: no response. Somebody has given up on the columns halfway down and written the word 'everyone'.
lore.deadlands.gov_ration.title: Ration Card
lore.deadlands.gov_ration.body: This card entitles the holder to one day's ration at any distribution point. Punched eleven times. The twelfth hole was never made.
lore.deadlands.gov_governor.title: Letter from the Governor's Office
lore.deadlands.gov_governor.body: The Governor thanks Colonel Hale for his discretion. The situation in Ashford County must not become a national story before the LANTERN material is secure. Additional resources will follow. They did not.
lore.deadlands.gov_school_notice.title: School Closure Notice
lore.deadlands.gov_school_notice.body: Ashford schools will close until further notice. The gym will serve as a fever screening centre. Parents should collect children by noon. Uncollected children will be evacuated with staff.
lore.deadlands.gov_quarantine_map.title: Quarantine Zone Map
lore.deadlands.gov_quarantine_map.body: A county map with three red circles drawn on it, each larger than the last, each dated a week apart. The last circle runs off the edge of the page.
lore.deadlands.gov_bounty.title: Notice: Looting
lore.deadlands.gov_bounty.body: Looters will be shot. This notice is signed by a sheriff who, according to the scrawl beneath it, was himself last seen leaving town with a pickup full of the hardware store.
lore.deadlands.news_1.title: Ashford Gazette: Mystery Fever
lore.deadlands.news_1.body: Day -89. Six residents hospitalised with a fever doctors cannot identify. Ashford General urges calm. A spokesperson for nearby Kessler Laboratory denied any connection to an 'unscheduled chemical release' reported last week.
lore.deadlands.news_2.title: Ashford Gazette: Hospital Under Strain
lore.deadlands.news_2.body: Day -78. Ashford General has suspended visiting hours as fever cases pass two hundred. Police report a rise in 'unprovoked assaults'. The Mayor asks residents to check on elderly neighbours, from a distance.
lore.deadlands.news_3.title: Ashford Gazette: Army Arrives
lore.deadlands.news_3.body: Day -66. Army vehicles were seen on the county road this morning. Officials describe their presence as 'precautionary'. Residents in the north of the county have been asked to prepare for possible relocation.
lore.deadlands.news_4.title: Ashford Gazette: Evacuation Begins
lore.deadlands.news_4.body: Day -61. Buses began carrying residents to Camp Meridian today. Colonel Marcus Hale told the Gazette the camp has 'room for everyone who needs it'. Queues stretched for two miles.
lore.deadlands.news_5.title: Ashford Gazette: Meridian Gates Closed
lore.deadlands.news_5.body: Day -59. Hundreds of families remain outside Camp Meridian after its gates were closed overnight. Army spokesmen refused to comment. Gunfire was heard near the perimeter. This edition was printed on a hand press.
lore.deadlands.news_6.title: Ashford Gazette: Last Edition
lore.deadlands.news_6.body: Day -42. This is the last edition. The phones are down, the power is down, the press is broken and our editor is missing. To whoever finds this: stay quiet after dark, stay off the main roads, and look after each other.
lore.deadlands.news_school.title: School Newsletter
lore.deadlands.news_school.body: This term: the science fair, the bake sale and our trip to the Kessler Laboratory open day! Thank you to Dr. Rourke for showing the year sixes around. They loved the animals.
lore.deadlands.news_classified.title: Classifieds Page
lore.deadlands.news_classified.body: FOR SALE: generator, never used. WANTED: anyone who has seen Mira, age 7, red coat. MISSING: grey cat. SWAP: car for a week of food. Somebody has circled the generator and written: SOLD, NOT PAID FOR, SORRY.
lore.deadlands.news_obituaries.title: Obituaries, Day -70
lore.deadlands.news_obituaries.body: The obituary page runs to fourteen pages, then stops halfway down the fifteenth, as if the person writing them gave up or ran out of time.
lore.deadlands.news_flyer.title: Church Flyer
lore.deadlands.news_flyer.body: Soup kitchen every evening at St. Brendan's. All welcome. Bring a bowl. Below, a later note: soup kitchen closed. All welcome still. Bring a weapon.
lore.deadlands.radio_ebs_1.title: Transcript: Emergency Broadcast
lore.deadlands.radio_ebs_1.body: This is the Emergency Broadcast System. A public health emergency is in effect for Ashford County. Remain indoors. Do not travel. Further information will follow. [The message repeats for eleven hours.]
lore.deadlands.radio_ebs_2.title: Transcript: Emergency Broadcast, Revised
lore.deadlands.radio_ebs_2.body: This is the Emergency Broadcast System. Camp Meridian is no longer accepting evacuees. Residents should shelter in place. Do not approach military checkpoints. [Static. A voice, off-mic: 'They can't say that.']
lore.deadlands.radio_ham_1.title: Ham Radio Log, Station K4-ASH
lore.deadlands.radio_ham_1.body: Day -45. Talked to a farm out west, a church downtown, two kids in a school attic. All fine for now. Day -41. Church not answering. Day -40. Nobody answering. Day -39. Keep transmitting anyway.
lore.deadlands.radio_ham_2.title: Ham Radio Log, Station K4-ASH (cont.)
lore.deadlands.radio_ham_2.body: Day -30. Somebody on 91.2. A woman calling herself Lily, trading news between settlements. Gave me the water status for the north pumps. First good news in weeks.
lore.deadlands.radio_pilot.title: Transcript: Rotary Chatter
lore.deadlands.radio_pilot.body: 'Calder, Dustoff Two, rotor's chewed, can't make the lift.' 'Dustoff Two, leave the bird, we are pulling out.' 'Copy, leaving the bird. Somebody should come back for her.' 'Nobody's coming back, Two.'
lore.deadlands.radio_last.title: Transcript: Final Broadcast, Station WASH
lore.deadlands.radio_last.body: This is WASH, Ashford's voice for forty years. I'm going to leave the music playing when I go. If you can hear it, you're not alone. Somebody chose that song for you. Goodnight, Ashford.
lore.deadlands.radio_distress.title: Recording: Distress Call
lore.deadlands.radio_distress.body: 'Anyone, please, we're at the farm by the water tower, there's four of us, one's hurt-' [noise] '-they're at the door-' [the recording ends. The tape has been played many times.]
lore.deadlands.radio_children.title: Recording: Two Voices
lore.deadlands.radio_children.body: 'Is it on?' 'It's on.' 'Hello, this is Sam and Priya, we're in the school roof, we have biscuits and a torch. If you're a grown-up please come. If you're a zombie please don't.' [giggling, then hushed]
lore.deadlands.radio_military_chatter.bo: 'Meridian Actual, perimeter north reports movement, large group.' 'Hold the line.' 'Sir, the group is civilians.' 'I said hold the line.' [long pause] 'Holding, sir.'
lore.deadlands.radio_unknown_1.title: Recording: 103.8
lore.deadlands.radio_unknown_1.body: [Static, then breathing. Then a voice, slow, as if remembering how:] 'H... not... gone.' [Static. The recording loops.]
lore.deadlands.radio_tower_manual.title: Radio Tower Maintenance Card
lore.deadlands.radio_tower_manual.body: If the transmitter is dead: check the fuses, replace the board, reseat the antenna feed. Keep spares in the hut. Spares are, of course, never in the hut.
lore.deadlands.radio_settlement.title: Transcript: 91.2, Settlement Roll Call
lore.deadlands.radio_settlement.body: 'This is the holdout at the old school, twelve of us, need antibiotics, have spare rounds.' 'Copy. This is the farm co-op, have food, need a mechanic.' 'This is Lily, I'll be by both within the week. Keep your gates shut and your kettles on.'
lore.deadlands.missing_mira.title: Missing: Mira, Age 7
lore.deadlands.missing_mira.body: Red coat, yellow boots, gap in her front teeth. Last seen at the Camp Meridian queue, day -60. If found, bring her to the farm co-op on the west road. We will wait. We will always wait.
lore.deadlands.missing_tom.title: Missing: Tom Brennan
lore.deadlands.missing_tom.body: Bus driver, 54. Took the 0700 school bus to Camp Meridian and did not come back. His wife has written on the bottom: Tom, if you read this, the dog is fine. Come home.
lore.deadlands.missing_twins.title: Missing: The Okonkwo Twins
lore.deadlands.missing_twins.body: Ada and Obi, 12. Separated from their mother at the school evacuation. A later line: Ada found safe at the farm co-op. Obi still missing. Please keep looking.
lore.deadlands.missing_wall.title: Photograph: The Missing Wall
lore.deadlands.missing_wall.body: A photograph of a wall covered in notes and pictures: faces, names, 'have you seen', 'please call', 'I'm at the church'. In the middle, someone has written in big letters: WE'RE STILL LOOKING.
lore.deadlands.missing_dog.title: Missing: Biscuit
lore.deadlands.missing_dog.body: Golden retriever, friendly, answers to Biscuit, terrified of thunder. Reward: everything we have left, which is not much. Under it, in a child's writing: and a hug.
lore.deadlands.missing_grandad.title: Missing: Walter Hughes
lore.deadlands.missing_grandad.body: 82, wanders, may be confused, likes to sit on benches. Needs his heart pills. Last seen walking towards the hospital, day -77. Someone has added: he was at the hospital, he was helping.
lore.deadlands.missing_soldier.title: Missing: Pvt. Ada Okafor
lore.deadlands.missing_soldier.body: Listed as a deserter by Camp Meridian command. Someone has crossed out 'deserter' and written 'hero' above it. Someone else has crossed that out. A third hand has written both again.
lore.deadlands.missing_teacher.title: Missing: Ms. Delgado
lore.deadlands.missing_teacher.body: Year six teacher. Stayed behind to make sure every child got on a bus. The last bus left without her. If you know where she is, please tell her class. They ask every day.
lore.deadlands.missing_family.title: Missing: The Hendersons
lore.deadlands.missing_family.body: Paul, Ruth, and their son Danny. Left by car for the coast, day -50. If you find this note at our house: we went west. We are sorry about the mess.
lore.deadlands.missing_vask.title: Police Notice: Leon Vask
lore.deadlands.missing_vask.body: Wanted for questioning in connection with missing livestock and an assault at Kessler Laboratory. Approach with caution. Last seen carrying a cleaver and a length of chain.
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_1.title: The Henderson Diary, 1
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_1.body: Paul says it's like the flu. Ruth says it isn't. I'm writing this down because Mum says if things get bad we should remember what happened. Things are already a bit bad. School is shut. Danny, 10.
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_2.title: The Henderson Diary, 2
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_2.body: Dad boarded up the windows. Mum filled the bath with water. Mr. Lewis next door was walking funny in his garden at night. Dad said not to look. I looked. Danny.
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_3.title: The Henderson Diary, 3
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_3.body: We're leaving for the coast. Dad says the roads west are clear. Mum cried when we left the house. I left my bike. I hope someone who needs it finds it. Danny.
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_4.title: The Henderson Diary, 4
lore.deadlands.journal_henderson_4.body: The car stopped. We walked. Dad hurt his leg. A lady with a big rucksack gave us water and told us which roads were safe. She said her name was Lily. Mum said she was an angel. Danny.
lore.deadlands.journal_delgado_1.title: Ms. Delgado's Register
lore.deadlands.journal_delgado_1.body: Register, day -61. Present: 24. Absent: 3. Collected by parents: 9. To be evacuated with staff: 15. I am staying until every one of them is on a bus.
lore.deadlands.journal_delgado_2.title: Ms. Delgado's Register, Later
lore.deadlands.journal_delgado_2.body: Buses: 2. Children: 15. Seats: 14. The driver says he'll come back. I sent the last child on my lap seat. I'll wait in the classroom. I've got marking to do anyway.
lore.deadlands.journal_delgado_3.title: Ms. Delgado's Last Lesson
lore.deadlands.journal_delgado_3.body: Written large on the classroom board: Today's lesson: courage. Courage is being scared and doing the right thing anyway. Homework: be brave. Look after each other. I'm proud of every one of you.
lore.deadlands.journal_clerk.title: Grocery Clerk's Notes
lore.deadlands.journal_clerk.body: Day -70: sold out of water. Day -68: sold out of everything. Day -65: manager left. Day -64: I gave the rest away. Day -63: people came back to thank me. Some came back for other reasons. I'm in the stockroom.
lore.deadlands.journal_trucker.title: Trucker's Logbook
lore.deadlands.journal_trucker.body: Load: medical supplies for Ashford General. Destination reached day -73. Nobody to sign. Left the load at the doors and wrote 'for whoever needs it' on the crates. Heading home. Home is six hundred miles. Wish me luck.
lore.deadlands.journal_priest.title: Father Doyle's Notebook
lore.deadlands.journal_priest.body: Day -48. Seventy people sleeping in the church. Day -44. Fifty. Day -40. The radio stopped today and with it, I think, the last of the hope. I am ringing the bell at noon anyway. It reminds them they're alive.
lore.deadlands.journal_kid_1.title: Sophie's Diary
lore.deadlands.journal_kid_1.body: Dear diary, today we played in the attic because it's safe. Mum says we're having an adventure. I don't think adventures are supposed to be this quiet. Mum says quiet is good now.
lore.deadlands.journal_kid_2.title: Sophie's Diary, Later
lore.deadlands.journal_kid_2.body: Dear diary, a nice soldier came. He had a scar and a funny name and he gave me his chocolate. He said his name was Felix and he was looking for a doctor. I told him to try the hospital because that's where doctors live.
lore.deadlands.journal_farmer.title: Farm Ledger
lore.deadlands.journal_farmer.body: Planted late. Harvest early. Fed nine families from the barn this month and turned away none. The dead don't eat corn, which is the only thing they've got going for them.
lore.deadlands.journal_mechanic.title: Garage Notice
lore.deadlands.journal_mechanic.body: Closed. Back when the world is. Left the good tools under the bench for anyone who can use them. Left the bad tools on the bench for anyone who can't tell the difference.
lore.deadlands.journal_student.title: A Student's Essay
lore.deadlands.journal_student.body: 'What I want to be when I grow up', by Ben, age 11. I want to be a doctor like the lady at the Kessler open day because she showed us how cells fix themselves. She said one day we'll fix anything. I hope it's soon.
lore.deadlands.journal_graffiti_1.title: Photograph: Graffiti, 'Quiet'
lore.deadlands.journal_graffiti_1.body: A photograph of a wall painted in big white letters: THEY HEAR YOU. Underneath, smaller: so whisper. Underneath that, smaller still: love you mum.
lore.deadlands.journal_graffiti_2.title: Photograph: Graffiti, 'Kessler'
lore.deadlands.journal_graffiti_2.body: A photograph of a bus shelter with KESSLER DID THIS sprayed across the timetable. Someone has added an arrow pointing to a phone number for the laboratory's public relations office.
lore.deadlands.journal_graffiti_3.title: Photograph: Graffiti, 'Meridian'
lore.deadlands.journal_graffiti_3.body: A photograph of a road sign for Camp Meridian. The word MERIDIAN has been crossed out and replaced with LIARS. Bullet holes run through the arrow.
lore.deadlands.journal_photo_family.body: A family on a beach, squinting into the sun. On the back: 'Best holiday ever. Same time next year!' The date is last summer.
lore.deadlands.journal_photo_lab.title: Photograph: Kessler Staff
lore.deadlands.journal_photo_lab.body: A staff photo on the laboratory steps. Third from the left, a woman holding a coffee cup is circled in pen: Harley. At the back, a tall man in a stained apron stands apart from the others.
lore.deadlands.journal_photo_brothers.bo: A soldier in dress uniform with his arm round a woman in a lab coat, both laughing. On the back: 'E & H, graduation day. Don't you dare re-enlist.' The soldier has the same eyes as she does.
lore.deadlands.journal_diner.title: Diner Order Pad
lore.deadlands.journal_diner.body: Table 4: two coffees, eggs. Table 6: pancakes, no syrup. Table 2: don't serve him, he's sick. Table 2: get out, get out, everyone get out. The rest of the pad is blank.
lore.deadlands.journal_bunker.title: Bunker Builder's Notes
lore.deadlands.journal_bunker.body: Twenty years everyone laughed at the bunker. Nobody is laughing now. Mostly because nobody else is around to laugh. Food for a year. Air filter. Books. No one to talk to. I should have built it bigger.
lore.deadlands.journal_ranger.title: Ranger's Notebook
lore.deadlands.journal_ranger.body: The wolves left the valley a week before the first case. The birds went quiet a day before. Animals knew. I wish I'd listened to them instead of the radio.
lore.deadlands.journal_expedition.title: Expedition Supply List
lore.deadlands.journal_expedition.body: Sample jars x40, cold box, field microscope, Felix's spare magazines, Itz's 'lucky' wrench, Lily's maps, enough coffee for Harley. Someone has added: and enough patience for Itz.
lore.deadlands.boss_ward_c_1.title: Ward C: Final Inspection
lore.deadlands.boss_ward_c_1.body: The door to Ward C has been forced outward. Inside, the beds have been dragged into the middle of the room and the walls are scored to head height. Whatever came out was not one thing. It was all of them, together.
lore.deadlands.boss_butcher_1.title: Leon's Ledger
lore.deadlands.boss_butcher_1.body: Fed them Monday. Fed them Tuesday. On Wednesday they took my animals away to the hospital in town. On Thursday I went to get them back. On Friday I was so hungry. I am still so hungry.
lore.deadlands.boss_warden_1.title: Hale's Personal Letter
lore.deadlands.boss_warden_1.body: Margaret, by the time you read this the camp will be closed and I will have done something I cannot undo. I told myself it was to save the country. It was to save the project. Burn this.
lore.deadlands.boss_experiment_1.title: E-12: Name
lore.deadlands.boss_experiment_1.body: Subject E-12 was admitted under the name Grace, a volunteer from the county hospital's cleaning staff. She was promised money for her children. Her children were evacuated to Camp Meridian. Ward C.
lore.deadlands.boss_pz_1.title: Rourke's Confession
lore.deadlands.boss_pz_1.body: I increased the dose because I wanted to see. That is the whole truth. Elias asked me to stop and I wanted to see. Whatever is walking out there wearing him is my work, not his.

npc.deadlands.option.elias: I need to tell you about Elias.
npc.deadlands.character.harley.recognise: You found my notes. Then you know what I am trying to do, %s. Sit. We start now.
npc.deadlands.character.itzbreadloaf.rec: You read my logbook? Then you know about the doctor. Is she alive? Tell me she is alive, %s.
npc.deadlands.character.imlilylol.recogn: One of my letters found you. They do that. I am Lily, %s. You have questions, I have prices.
npc.deadlands.character.felixsyn.recogni: You have my notes. So you know about Meridian. Then you know why I do not trust uniforms, %s.
quest.deadlands.harley.missing: I need everything we lost: what the hospital kept, what Kessler hid, what the army took to Meridian, my field case from the expedition camp, and my notes. Look in the journal; I have marked what I know.
quest.deadlands.harley.field_case: My field case. You found it. The seals held. Half my work is in here and I thought I would never see it again.
quest.deadlands.harley.reveal: I have read all of it. The army had our data three months before the first case. They knew what NR-7 could do and they planned a fence, not a cure. Take this card; it opened Kessler's labs once. Now we finish what they would not.
quest.deadlands.harley.cure_need: To make an inhibitor I still need %s more things. The journal has the list.
quest.deadlands.harley.delivered: That is %s more. Thank you. I still need %s.
quest.deadlands.harley.cure_start: That is everything. Everything. Give me a day. Keep the fire going and do not let anyone open the crate with the samples.
quest.deadlands.harley.cure_wait: Not yet. Close. Leave me to it.
quest.deadlands.harley.cure_done: It works. It actually works: it stops the turning in the first hours. Now we need to get it to someone who can make ten thousand of it. We need a way out.
quest.deadlands.harley.cure_done_calder: It works. And if Lily is right about Site Calder, we have a way out. Get that helicopter flying.
quest.deadlands.harley.ready: The helicopter is ready? Then go to it when you are ready to decide. I will be there.
quest.deadlands.harley.elias: He was in there. All that time, he was holding it back. With his blood I do not have to stop at prevention. I can bring them back, the ones who turned recently. Elias did this. Let his name be on it.
quest.deadlands.itzbreadloaf.ask: The van needs three engine parts and two tires. You have %s parts and %s tires on you. I am not fussy about where they come from.
quest.deadlands.itzbreadloaf.thanks: She runs! Listen to her. Here, have some fuel, and my old logbook. When it is time to leave, I am driving. Or riding. Whatever gets us out.
quest.deadlands.itzbreadloaf.after: The van is purring. I keep it ready. Say the word.
quest.deadlands.imlilylol.ask: If one of the radio towers worked, I could reach every settlement in the county. Find a tower, fix its transmitter. You will need radio parts and a wrench.
quest.deadlands.imlilylol.thanks: I can hear them! All of them. Here: my letter about Site Calder. There is a helicopter there, if the soldier was not lying. I will come when you go.
quest.deadlands.imlilylol.thanks_felix: I can hear them! And one of them is Felix: he is holding at %s, %s of here, about %s blocks. Here is my letter about Site Calder. I will come when you go.
quest.deadlands.imlilylol.after: The air is busy now. People are finding each other. That is your doing.
quest.deadlands.felixsyn.ask: The evacuation orders. The real ones, signed. They should still be at one of the Meridian camps. Bring them to me.
quest.deadlands.felixsyn.orders_read: That is his signature. Order 0300. Now the Colonel. If he is out there, dead and walking, somebody has to stop him. I would rather it was us.
quest.deadlands.felixsyn.need_warden: The orders are proof. But Hale is still out there. Until he is at rest, I am not going anywhere.
quest.deadlands.felixsyn.thanks: It is done. Take this card; it opens the motor pool and the hangar at Calder. When the helicopter flies, I will be on it.
quest.deadlands.felixsyn.after: I sleep a little better now. A little.

radio.deadlands.emergency.shelter: This is the Emergency Broadcast System. A public health emergency is in effect. Remain indoors. Do not travel. Do not approach the sick.
radio.deadlands.emergency.automated: This message is automated. The emergency services are not responding. If you can hear this, shelter, ration water, and stay quiet after dark.
radio.deadlands.emergency.horde_tonight: WARNING: Large movement of infected expected tonight. Barricade. Do not sleep in the open.
radio.deadlands.emergency.threat_tonight: WARNING: An unidentified threat is moving through the county tonight. Avoid it. Do not engage.

radio.deadlands.emergency.tip.1: Treat all bites as infected. Seek a doctor within the hour.
radio.deadlands.emergency.tip.2: Keep lights low and doors closed after dark.
radio.deadlands.emergency.tip.3: Vehicles attract attention. Use them sparingly.
radio.deadlands.emergency.tip.4: Splint broken limbs. Do not walk on them.
radio.deadlands.emergency.tip.5: Help your neighbours. Survival is not a solo effort.

radio.deadlands.survivors.distress: Mayday, mayday, %s, we lost people last night, we need help, grid %s, %s, anyone...
radio.deadlands.survivors.itzbreadloaf: Itz here, anyone with tyres or engine parts, I'm near %s, about %s, %s. Bring a doctor if you've got one.
radio.deadlands.survivors.imlilylol: Lily on the road. Trading out of %s for a few days, round %s, %s. Bring me news, I'll make it worth your while.
radio.deadlands.survivors.felixsyn: F.S., holding at %s, %s, %s. Civilians needing escort, come to me. Army, stay away.
radio.deadlands.survivors.lily_relay: Lily relaying: settlements, keep your gates shut at dusk and your radios on. We are not alone out here.
radio.deadlands.survivors.quiet: Nobody is talking. Just the hiss of the carrier and someone breathing.
radio.deadlands.military.faint: ...cal...er... rec...ll... grid... [too faint. A radio tower might carry it further.]
radio.deadlands.military.recall: Automated recall, Site Calder. All units report to grid %s, %s. Rotary-wing asset remains on site. Repeat: rotary-wing asset remains on site.
radio.deadlands.military.recall_unknown: Automated recall, Site Calder. Grid reference corrupted. Rotary-wing asset remains on site.

radio.deadlands.military.meridian.1: [Archived] Meridian, Ward C reports structural failure. Request instructions. [No reply is recorded.]
radio.deadlands.military.meridian.2: [Archived] All personnel: gates seal at 0300. Personnel who refuse are to be treated as deserters.
radio.deadlands.military.hale_silent: The Meridian loop has stopped. Someone has switched it off.

radio.deadlands.unknown.whisper.3: ...rain... I walked out into the rain... I opened all the doors...
radio.deadlands.unknown.kessler: ...Wing D... Kessler... %s... %s... where it started... where I started...
radio.deadlands.unknown.silent: Nothing on 103.8 now. Just silence. It sounds like rest.
intro.deadlands.title: Day 0
intro.deadlands.line.1: Day -90. A fever no doctor could name.
intro.deadlands.line.2: Day -75. The hospitals filled. Then they emptied.
intro.deadlands.line.3: Day -60. The army came. The gates closed.
intro.deadlands.line.4: Day -40. The radios went quiet. Day -20. Everything else did.
intro.deadlands.line.5: You do not remember the last ninety days.
intro.deadlands.line.6: Day 0. Someone has kept you alive. Her name is Harley.
intro.deadlands.line.6.alone: Day 0. You wake alone. Somewhere near, someone kept a fire going.

ending.deadlands.choice.cure_missing: The cure is not finished. You could leave anyway.

ending.deadlands.extraction.title: EXTRACTION
ending.deadlands.extraction.body: The rotor catches and the ground falls away. Below, Ashford County spreads out grey and green and still. Harley holds the cold box on her knees and does not let go of it once. Somewhere beyond the hills there are labs with power, and people who will make ten thousand doses of what she made in a tent. For the first time in ninety days, the future is a place you are going to.
ending.deadlands.rescue.title: RESCUE
ending.deadlands.rescue.body: You did not wait for the cure. Maybe you could not. The helicopter climbs and Harley watches the county shrink, her notes in her lap, unfinished. Everyone aboard is alive, and that is not nothing. It might even be enough. She is already writing down what she will need when they land.
ending.deadlands.stay.title: STAYING BEHIND
ending.deadlands.stay.body: You watch the helicopter until it is a speck, then nothing. Harley is taking the cure to people who can make more of it. You are taking it to people who need it now. Settlement by settlement, gate by gate, the word goes out: there is something that works. The dead still walk. Fewer of the living join them.
ending.deadlands.patient_zero.title: PATIENT ZERO
ending.deadlands.patient_zero.body: Elias held it back for weeks, alone, in the dark of his own head. His blood remembers how. Harley works without sleeping, and on the ninth day a woman who turned that morning opens her eyes and asks for water. The world does not end today. It starts to come back, one person at a time, and every vial carries his name.

mission.deadlands.harley.static.descript: Harley's receiver is dead. With it working she could listen for the others from the lab.
mission.deadlands.harley.static.ask: My receiver's dead. If I can get it working I can listen for the others from the lab. Two sets of radio parts and a fuse. Bring them here.
mission.deadlands.harley.static.reminder: Two radio parts and a fuse. The receiver won't fix itself.
mission.deadlands.harley.static.thanks: That's it. Give me an hour with these and we'll hear more than static.
mission.deadlands.harley.cold_chain.desc: Something at the lab was kept cold for as long as the power lasted. Harley needs power and clean water to move it.
mission.deadlands.harley.cold_chain.ask: There's something at the lab I kept cold as long as the power lasted. To move it I need a car battery and two purification tablets. Please.
mission.deadlands.harley.cold_chain.remi: A car battery and two purification tablets. It won't keep forever.
mission.deadlands.harley.cold_chain.than: Here. It's sealed, don't open it. The project number on the label is Adam's. He'll know what it means better than I do. Take it to him.
mission.deadlands.harley.cold_chain.wher: Harley: Adam's alive. Last I heard he was holed up at %s, %s, %s.
mission.deadlands.story.the_case.descrip: Harley gave you a sealed sample case with Adam's project number on it. Take it to him.
mission.deadlands.story.the_case.waiting: Harley sent you? Then she gave you something. Bring it here.
mission.deadlands.story.the_case.adam.1: Where did you... Harley had this?
mission.deadlands.story.the_case.adam.2: This is batch seven. I sealed it myself, the week before everything went wrong. If it's still intact...
mission.deadlands.story.the_case.adam.3: Sit down. I need to think. And then I need to show you something.
item.deadlands.sealed_sample_case.desc: From the regional lab. A project number on the seal. Do not open.
npc.deadlands.character.adam.greeting: %s. You're real. Sorry. I stopped trusting what I see a while ago.
npc.deadlands.character.adam.story.0: I ran a team at the regional lab. Harley and I worked across the hall from each other for eleven years.
npc.deadlands.character.adam.story.1: I promised my wife I'd be home by seven every night. I was, the night it started. Then I went back for the samples.
npc.deadlands.character.adam.story.2: Lily would tell me I'm being an idiot. She always could. Felix would just pack a bag and come with me.
npc.deadlands.character.adam.story.3: I'm not a soldier. I keep telling myself that's an excuse. It isn't. It's just true.
npc.deadlands.character.adam.talk: Not now. When Harley's ready, she'll find you. She always does.
lore.deadlands.adam_research_1.title: Adam's Lab Notes: Sample Stability Log
lore.deadlands.adam_research_1.body: Cold chain for the NR-7 trial batches. Batches one to six degrade within ninety days at four degrees. Batch seven was drawn before the agent was modified for the trial and holds at minus eighty. If anyone ever needs to know what NR-7 was before they changed it, batch seven is the answer.
lore.deadlands.adam_research_2.title: Adam's Lab Notes: The Modification
lore.deadlands.adam_research_2.body: Rourke wants faster regeneration for the trial. Faster means fewer brakes. I put my objection in writing, twice. Both memos came back with a colonel's initials on them and nothing else.
lore.deadlands.adam_research_3.title: Adam's Lab Notes: Comparison
lore.deadlands.adam_research_3.body: Ran the trial agent against batch seven under the scope. Batch seven repairs and stops. The trial agent repairs and keeps going. Whatever turns a person into one of them lives in the difference between those two slides.
lore.deadlands.adam_research_4.title: Adam's Lab Notes: Sealed
lore.deadlands.adam_research_4.body: Sealed batch seven in a transport case and put it in Harley's freezer, not mine. Mine is on the log they check. Hers is not. If I'm wrong about all this, I wasted an afternoon. If I'm right, someone will need it.
lore.deadlands.adam_tape_1.title: Recording: Adam, Voice Memo 1
lore.deadlands.adam_tape_1.body: [Tape hiss] It's me. The phones are down at the lab, so I'm recording this in case the post still works. I'm fine. I'm coming home. Keep the doors locked and don't open them for anyone in uniform. I love you. All three of you.
lore.deadlands.adam_tape_2.title: Recording: Adam, Voice Memo 2
lore.deadlands.adam_tape_2.body: [Tape hiss] Day nine, I think. I keep recording these. It helps to talk to you even if you can't hear it. The roads north are blocked. I'll find another way. I always find another way home. Don't give up on me.
lore.deadlands.adam_tape_3.title: Recording: Adam, Voice Memo 3
lore.deadlands.adam_tape_3.body: [Tape hiss] Someone told me a group got out of town before the bridge went. A woman and two kids. Could be anyone. Could be you. I'm choosing to believe it's you.
lore.deadlands.adam_photo.title: Photograph: A Family on a Pier
lore.deadlands.adam_photo.body: A creased photograph from a lab coat pocket. A man in glasses, a woman laughing at something off camera, two children squinting into the sun. On the back, in pen: Summer. Home by seven, I promise.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.descri: Adam left his field notebook in his office at the Kessler research facility. Everything he knows about batch seven is in it.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.ask.1: Batch seven is only half of it. The other half is in my field notebook: every test, every number.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.ask.2: I left it in my office at Kessler when we ran. Third floor, under the desk. I can't go back in there. I've tried.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.ask.3: Bring it to me. And if you see a photo in there, a family on a pier, bring that too. Please.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.waitin: The notebook's at Kessler. Leather cover, my handwriting all over it. You can't miss it.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.adam.1: That's it. That's my handwriting. I thought I'd never see this again.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.adam.2: With this and batch seven, Harley and I can work out what they changed. And maybe how to change it back.
mission.deadlands.story.adams_lab.adam.3: My wife used to say I'd lose my head if it wasn't attached. She'd laugh at me for this. I hope she's somewhere she can laugh.
item.deadlands.adam_field_notebook.desc: Leather cover, water stained. Every page in the same careful hand.
achievement.deadlands.story.adams_lab.de: Bring Adam his field notebook from Kessler.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.0: Ninety-five days ago, something got out of the Kessler Regional Research Laboratory.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.1: They called it NR-7. It was built to heal wounded soldiers.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.2: It healed. It just never stopped. Ashford County fell in a month.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.3: At Camp Meridian, the army closed the gates on two hundred people.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.4: One soldier put down his rifle and walked out. His name is FelixSyn.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.5: Itzbreadloaf kept an old van running and went back for anyone he could find.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.6: Adam ran a team at the lab. He knows what NR-7 was before they changed it. He is still looking for his family.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.9: FelixSyn hasn't heard from her since the night it started. He doesn't know where she is. He hasn't stopped looking.
cutscene.deadlands.outbreak_intro.title: DEADLANDS
cutscene.deadlands.reunion.2: Harley: Ten days. I told myself you'd find a way. I didn't let myself believe it.
cutscene.deadlands.reunion.3: FelixSyn: I walked out of Meridian with nothing. I asked every survivor I met about a doctor named Harley.
cutscene.deadlands.reunion.5: FelixSyn: I'm not losing you again. Not to this.
cutscene.deadlands.reunion.6: Harley: This is who kept me going out here. Felix, meet the reason I'm still standing.
disaster.deadlands.twister.title: Twister
disaster.deadlands.twister.warning: The air has gone still and the clouds are turning. A twister is forming. Find a basement or solid walls.
disaster.deadlands.twister.start: A twister is on the ground!
disaster.deadlands.flash_flood.title: Flash Flood
disaster.deadlands.flash_flood.warning: The river is roaring upstream. A flash flood is coming. Get to high ground.
disaster.deadlands.flash_flood.start: Flash flood! Stay off low ground!
disaster.deadlands.tremor.title: Tremor
disaster.deadlands.tremor.warning: Birds are leaving the trees all at once. The ground hums under your feet.
disaster.deadlands.tremor.start: Tremor! Get away from anything that can fall!
disaster.deadlands.skyfall.title: Skyfall
disaster.deadlands.skyfall.warning: Streaks of light are crossing the sky. Something is coming down.
disaster.deadlands.skyfall.start: Skyfall! Burning rock is hitting the ground!
disaster.deadlands.whiteout.title: Whiteout
disaster.deadlands.whiteout.warning: The temperature is dropping fast. A whiteout is rolling in. Get indoors and get warm.
disaster.deadlands.whiteout.start: Whiteout! You can't see your own hands.
disaster.deadlands.dust_wall.title: Dust Wall
disaster.deadlands.dust_wall.warning: A brown wall is rising on the horizon. A dust storm is coming. Cover your face.
disaster.deadlands.caustic_rain.title: Caustic Rain
disaster.deadlands.caustic_rain.warning: The clouds have a sick green tinge. The rain that's coming burns. Get under cover or wear a helmet.
disaster.deadlands.caustic_rain.start: Caustic rain! It burns your skin!
disaster.deadlands.static_storm.title: Static Storm
disaster.deadlands.static_storm.warning: Your hair is standing on end. A lightning storm is building right on top of you.
disaster.deadlands.static_storm.start: Static storm! Stay away from open ground!
lore.deadlands.trail_hope_register.title: Checkpoint Register, North Road
lore.deadlands.trail_hope_register.body: Page 14 of a soaked register. Name, number in party, destination. Halfway down, in a careful hand: one adult, two children, destination Pinecrest. Someone has added in pencil beside it: father not with them, still at the lab?
lore.deadlands.trail_hope_radio.title: Recording: Night Traffic, 91.2
lore.deadlands.trail_hope_radio.body: [Static] ...convoy from the north road reached the reservoir. Forty-one people. Women, kids, two dogs. If you're out there looking for someone, Pinecrest is taking names. Say it again: Pinecrest is taking names. [Static]
lore.deadlands.trail_hope_drawing.title: Photograph: A Child's Drawing
lore.deadlands.trail_hope_drawing.body: A crayon drawing, folded small. A house with every window yellow, three stick figures in a car, a fourth by the door. Under the fourth one, in big wobbly letters: DAD WILL FIND US.
lore.deadlands.adam_family_letter.title: A Letter on the Kitchen Table
lore.deadlands.adam_family_letter.body: Adam. If you're reading this, you came home. We waited four days. The soldiers say the north road is still open, so we're going to the reservoir camp at Pinecrest. The kids made me promise to leave the porch light on. There's no power, but I left it switched on anyway. We are all right. We are together. Home by seven, remember? We're holding you to it. All my love.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.descri: Adam can't make himself go home. He asked you to look for him: the house, and whoever might still be there.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.ask.1: There's something I haven't done. I haven't gone home. I keep telling myself it's too far. It isn't.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.ask.2: If I go and it's empty, I don't know what I do next. If I go and it isn't... I'm scared of that too.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.ask.3: Will you look for me? Just look. Then come back and tell me, whatever it is.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.where: Adam: My house is at %s, %s, %s. The one with the porch light.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.found: You found a letter on the kitchen table.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.waitin: Did you go? You don't have to say anything yet. Just... when you're ready.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.adam.1: Pinecrest. They went to Pinecrest. They waited four days for me.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.adam.2: She left the porch light on. Of course she did. There's no power and she left it on anyway.
mission.deadlands.story.the_house.adam.3: They're out there. They're together. That's more than I let myself hope for. Now I just have to get there.
achievement.deadlands.story.the_house.de: Find the letter Adam's family left and bring him the news.
cutscene.deadlands.family_house.0: The porch light is switched on. There has been no power here for months.
cutscene.deadlands.family_house.1: Adam. If you're reading this, you came home. We waited four days.
cutscene.deadlands.family_house.2: The soldiers say the north road is still open. We're going to the reservoir camp at Pinecrest.
cutscene.deadlands.family_house.3: The kids made me promise to leave the porch light on. I left it switched on anyway.
cutscene.deadlands.family_house.4: We are all right. We are together. Home by seven, remember? We're holding you to it.
lore.deadlands.asesino_file_1.title: Ashford Sheriff's Office: The Night Caller
lore.deadlands.asesino_file_1.body: Six victims over nine years, always after dark, always alone, always in town. He telephones first. Nobody has ever heard what he says, because nobody who answered lived. Composite sketch attached: medium height, masked, works with a blade.
lore.deadlands.asesino_file_2.title: Custody Transfer, Inmate 4471
lore.deadlands.asesino_file_2.body: Inmate transferred from county holding to Kessler Regional Research Laboratory for the LANTERN trial, cohort V (violent offenders). Restraints at all times. Do not let him see which of the staff walks home alone.
lore.deadlands.asesino_file_3.title: Trial Note: Cohort V, Subject 3
lore.deadlands.asesino_file_3.body: NR-7 has done to him what it did to the others, with one exception. The others forgot how to hunt with patience. He did not. He waits. He picks. He follows the one at the back. We are asking for the subject to be destroyed. Request denied.
